thread:
Marco: heads up — after the kernel-selection tweak rolled yesterday I'm seeing steady memory growth on longctx workloads (32k). looks like KV slot churn + int8 compaction interacting badly.
Juno: can you dump the heap/profile? quick sample please.
Marco: pasted a condensed snapshot below. short run with repeated long prompts.
Marco: ```
KV slots: total=1.2M used=820k free=380k
int8-pages: allocated=620MB compacted=120MB
slot-frag: external=44%
recent-access-ttl: 24s
resident-rss: 13.6GB -> 17.8GB over 30m
errors: none in logs, but latency jitter increased ~12%
```
Ashley: that resident jump is big. perf-bot samples? @perf-bot any regression alerts?
perf-bot: perf-bot: alert: mem-growth-rate exceeded threshold on branch "kernel-selection-heuristics" — investigation tag created PV-4589.
Juno: hmm — looks like compaction is freeing but fragmentation remains high. maybe int8 page packing introduces holes when slots are freed out of order.
Liam: Repro checklist: which model, seq len distribution, batch heuristics?
Marco: model: redwood/open-13B, seq dist: many 16k+ tails, batching: continuous-batch policy with 2s cut.
Marta: we saw similar before with int8 quant + slot reuse — accuracy drift was small but nontrivial when KV pages were partially evicted then restored. any eval diffs?
Marco: ran quick eval vs bf16 baseline: token perplexity delta +0.8%, Rouge-L delta -0.6 on our prompt set. Not catastrophic but correlated with int8 compaction enabled.
Juno: important: is the regression from quantization itself or from stale hot-prefixes being paged out and reloaded with lower precision?
Ashley: telemetry shows cold reloads spike when eviction threshold at 70% used. increasing threshold to 85% reduced reloads but increased mem. we need a better middle ground.
Liam: could we try selective-pin for top-5% hot slots (by freq) to keep them in resident set while allowing compaction elsewhere? cheap to prototype.
Marta: also consider temporarily disabling int8 in the compaction path — leave int8 pages allocated but skip in-place compaction that creates gaps. test tradeoffs: mem vs accuracy.
Marco: tried a local flag kv.int8.compact=false — memory growth stabilized, resident ~14.2GB and perf metrics returned near-baseline. accuracy restored to bf16 baseline within noise. downside: allocated memory goes up ~400MB.
Juno: that's a good signal — compaction is the likely trigger for fragmentation leading to inaccurate reload patterns.
Ashley: action items: 1) run 24h smoke with selective-pin heuristic (owner @Liam) 2) run 24h with compaction disabled for int8 (owner @Marco) 3) collect evals on both for accuracy and token-cost delta (owner @Marta).
Liam: starting selective-pin job now on canary pool. config snippet:
Liam: ```json
{"kv.pin_percent":5, "kv.pin_policy":"freq-decay", "kv.eviction_threshold":0.80}
```
Marta: I'll automate evals nightly and push results to the perf dashboard. want rank/rouge/perplexity plus token-cost per request.
perf-bot: perf-bot: scheduled job PV-4590 (selective-pin canary) and PV-4591 (int8-compaction-off) created. results expected in ~26h.
Marco: also adding new telemetry: slot-age histogram, hole-fragmentation-by-page, and int8-page-compact-count. will send PR with metrics.
Juno: good. if selective-pin recovers accuracy with lower mem impact than compaction-off we have a neat mitigation. otherwise we'll need a smarter allocator (coalescing neighbouring holes at heatmap level).
Ashley: ping me once canary is stable. thanks team :thumbsup:
Marco: thanks — will report back with PR and canary logs.
